object: Given sequences/stoichiometry of a putative protein complex; separately arbitrary candidateproteinpairs for interface-basedinteractionranking.
input_information: Each monomer amino-acidsequence, its MSA from sequence libraries and monomer structuraltemplates; known or hypothesized component/stoichiometrycontext. UnpairedMSAs are padded into fullcomplexlength; residueindices distinguishchains; no explicit complex-template search.
representation_fusion: Reuse AF2 monomerDLmodels, optionally AF-MultimerDLmodels, without retraining; assemble monomer features, jointly predict complexcoordinates throughAF2. piTM/interface-score use predictedalignmenterror over predictedinterface residues; confidence0-1 is not measured affinity/calibratedbiologicalprobability.
labels_units: Poseassessment uses experimentalPDBcomplexcoordinates; DockQ unitless [0,1] quality bands. PPIassessment labels CP17truepairs positive, naively allother34-proteinpaircombinations negative. E.coli701previouslycuratedpositivepairs,6849randomlyselectedputative negatives,~1:10 afterlengthfilter. CP17 coordinate result is target-level interface-score-selected best-of15 from3 independent runs×5models; the561pair screen instead has1run perpair, not1model.
actual_output: 复合物坐标及接口置信度；可另用于直接互作候选筛选，仍非亲和力/校准发生概率。 CP17坐标质量结果使用每目标3×5候选、按interface-score从15选top；561对筛选另为每对single run，非single model。
